blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Loren Legarda admitted she was wrong to join the group led by now Senate Minority Leader Alan Peter Cayetano when he snatched the Senate presidency after a leadership coup on May 11, according to Sen. Panfilo Lacson. “The last time we talked, she admitted that she made a mistake. I told her to forget about it, and that it’s over,” Lacson said in an interview with radio dwIZ over the weekend. Legarda also lamented that Senate Pro Tempore Vicente Sotto III was not answering her messages when she tried to reach out to him. Cayetano took over […]...
